ios.desc:
CanvasPrism is a fully offline, private whiteboard for iPhone and iPad. Everything you create is stored right on your device. There's no account, no sign-up, and no internet connection required to draw, sketch, or edit. Your ideas stay yours.

Open a blank board and start working in seconds.

• Infinite canvas for freehand sketching with shapes, arrows, lines, and text
• Build flowcharts, mind maps, and wireframes using smart shape connectors
• Ready-made component libraries and templates to start fast
• Apple Pencil support on iPad with native double-tap and squeeze gestures for a natural, hand-drawn feel
• Customize with 100+ bundled fonts, color themes, and background styles
• Set dark or light appearance per board for full control over every canvas
• Export to PNG, PDF, or SVG with an optional transparent background
• Open and import .excalidraw and .excalidrawlib files
• Share your work straight to Photos or Files

Want your boards on every device? Turn on optional iCloud sync to keep your iPhone and iPad in step. Sync is conflict-safe: if a board is edited in two places at once, CanvasPrism keeps an automatic copy so nothing is ever lost. Leave it off and CanvasPrism stays completely offline and on-device.

CanvasPrism is built on the open-source Excalidraw engine, running natively in the app for a fast, responsive drawing experience.

CanvasPrism is is completely free with no ads, no tracking and no account. Just a clean, capable whiteboard that's ready whenever inspiration strikes.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Present and Build Whiteboards, Flowcharts and Diagrams on iPhone

quotes.text: Hi HN! I built a native iPhone and iPad whiteboard app on top of the open source Excalidraw libraries, combining them with several other open source components to create a polished offline experience. I also added features like AirPlay presentation mode with an integrated laser pointer, along with over 100 fonts and 400 backgrounds for customization. It was a fun project that brings together a lot of great open source work into a native iOS app. It's completely free to use. There are no ads, tracking, no purchases, or anything like that. I use Excalidraw a lot, and I wanted something I can play with on my phone. Please give it a try and let me know if you run into any bugs. Thanks
